title: Townsend Brown workbooks posted online

tellings.quote: somebody just posted on the internet the workbooks Thompson from

plain: In 2025 someone posted online the workbooks of Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor who worked on ideas for moving craft using electricity instead of ordinary engines. Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents who says he handled UFO material, mentions it in passing, saying "somebody just posted on the internet the workbooks". He does not say who posted them, but it would put Brown's own notes in public hands.
